data.name: Hama
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Hama was a goddess of love and affection, often referred to as the 'beloved sister'. She was a patroness of domesticity, fertility, and the home. In Christian tradition, Hama may be seen as a symbol of the unconditional love and loyalty of a sister, or as a reminder of the importance of cherishing and caring for one's family.
